title: Our services
summary: This page provides an overview of the various services and resources available from Service NSW.

internal_links.text: Find a Service NSW location There are Service NSW locations all across the state. Use our map locator to find one near you.
Visual Stories An easy step-by-step guide on visiting a service centre and transactions
Be seen with a Sunflower Learn about how Service NSW supports a welcoming environment for all our customers through the Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program.
Book an appointment at a service centre To avoid wait times or delays at the service centre, book an appointment online.
Help in your language Find out about language translation on our website and interpreter services that you can access face-to-face, by video or over the phone.
Quiet Hour Service NSW offers Quiet Hour in service centres across Sydney and regional areas.

Payment methods and fees Our payment options include online, by phone or in person depending on the transaction. To pay with cash, check that the service centre you plan to visit accepts cash payments.
Getting your photo taken at a service centre Photos we take of you at Service NSW Centres need to meet certain guidelines.
Your responsibilities Our teams and customers all deserve to feel safe and to be treated with respect.

About Service NSW online services Service NSW delivers a one-stop-shop for citizens through its omnichannel network which includes the Service NSW website, MyServiceNSW Account and the Service NSW app.
A to Z list of transaction topics Browse transactions available online, over the phone or at a service centre.
Find services Start exploring content on the Service NSW website via our digital wayfinder, where we have topics organised under 12 main categories.
Get help with your MyServiceNSW Account How to create, log in, manage and update your details in your MyServiceNSW Account.
Access digital licences through the Service NSW app Download the Service NSW app to easily access government services, digital licences and credentials, and vouchers.
Website accessibility Our aim is to provide equal access to information for all our customers, regardless of their ability or environment.

faqs.q: How can I find a Service NSW location?
faqs.a: You can use the map locator to find a Service NSW location near you.

faqs.q: Do I need to book an appointment before visiting a service centre?
faqs.a: Booking an appointment online can help you avoid wait times or delays at the service centre.

faqs.q: What payment methods do I need for a transaction?
faqs.a: Payment options include online, by phone, or in person, depending on the transaction.

faqs.q: How can I access government services digitally?
faqs.a: You can access services through the Service NSW app or via the online services portal.
